name: US online menopause treatment prices
description: Every self-pay price this site records for menopause treatment at US online services: estradiol as a patch, gel, spray, pill or vaginal product, progesterone, combined products, testosterone for women, compounded hormones, and the non-hormonal hot flash prescriptions (Veozah, Lynkuet, low-dose paroxetine). Each row carries the price as the service's own page words it, the 30-day cost with any membership charged on top, what starting costs, whether the service bills insurance or takes an HSA or FSA card, the date it was read and the page it was read on.
attribution: MenoCost.com, US online menopause treatment prices, https://menocost.com/data

columns.name: price_id
columns.description: Stable identifier of the price: service, treatment and product.

columns.name: service
columns.description: The online service that sells the treatment, by its own name.

columns.name: service_type
columns.description: Menopause clinic online, online clinic with a menopause program, compounded hormones online, or clinic network.

columns.name: treatment
columns.description: The treatment the product is, e.g. "Estradiol patch" or "Veozah (fezolinetant)".

columns.name: product
columns.description: The product as the service's page names it.

columns.name: compounded
columns.description: yes for a compounded product (not FDA-approved), no for an FDA-approved one, empty when the page does not say.

columns.name: advertised_price
columns.description: The price in the service's own words, e.g. "$100.00 1-month supply ... Shipped and billed every 3 months."

columns.name: price_usd_30_days
columns.description: The price for 30 days of the product, in US dollars. Empty when the page gives no price that converts to 30 days.

columns.name: price_is_calculated
columns.description: yes when the 30-day price is this site's division of a supply price (e.g. a 90-day price divided by 3), no when the page states a monthly price.

columns.name: supply_price_usd
columns.description: The price of a supply when the page prices one (e.g. 90 days), in US dollars.

columns.name: supply_days
columns.description: Days the supply price buys.

columns.name: plan_months
columns.description: Months a plan bills or ships at once, when more than one.

columns.name: starting_from
columns.description: yes when the page gives the price as a starting point ("from", "starting at").

columns.name: membership_added_usd
columns.description: A membership the service charges every patient on top of this price, per month, when its page says so.

columns.name: cost_per_30_days_with_membership_usd
columns.description: The 30-day price plus that membership: the figure the site's lists compare.

columns.name: start_fee_usd
columns.description: What starting costs once before the first medication (a consult, a first visit, labs), as the page states it. Never added to the 30-day figure.

columns.name: includes
columns.description: What the price includes, in the page's terms.

columns.name: bills_insurance
columns.description: yes or no as the service's pages state whether it bills insurance; empty when they do not say.

columns.name: hsa_fsa
columns.description: yes or no as the service's pages state whether an HSA or FSA card pays; empty when they do not say.

columns.name: all_50_states
columns.description: yes when the service's pages say it serves all 50 states, no when they name states it does not serve; empty when they do not say.

columns.name: checked_on
columns.description: The date (UTC) the price was last read on its source page (YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: still_on_page_on
columns.description: The last date (UTC) the daily check found every amount of this price still on its source page, when that is later than checked_on; blank when no later check found it.

columns.name: review_status
columns.description: current within 30 days of checked_on; overdue after that, when the price is kept only as a dated reference.

columns.name: source_url
columns.description: The service's own page the price was read on.

columns.name: referral_program
columns.description: yes when this site may earn a referral fee from the service. It lifts the service in the site's default order (disclosed beside every list); every lowest-price list ignores it.

columns.name: page
columns.description: This site's page for the service, with every price in context.
